hero.subtitle: The digital logbook for paragliding and hang gliding - SHV approved

features.title: Features
features.intro: Everything you need after landing — in one app.

items.title: Log flights
items.description: Log every flight: take-off and landing sites with the details that matter to you. And manage all your wings, so you always know their age and how many flights they have.

items.title: Visualise tracks
items.description: Upload IGC files straight from your vario or tracker, collect them and analyse your flights without submitting them publicly anywhere.

items.title: Analyse statistics
items.description: Flights per year, airtime or income from tandem work: in the app you can filter and adjust your numbers exactly as you need.

items.title: Export data
items.description: So you never lose your data, you can export it as Excel at any time. And at the SHV exam, the PDF export serves as your approved logbook.

items.title: Import data
items.description: Coming from another logbook? Flights, gliders and places import from other formats — with a report of what was added, updated or already there.

items.title: Read tracks on the map
items.description: The IGC track sits on a shaded-relief map, climb and sink are colour coded, and the flight can be replayed.

items.title: Take-off and landing sites
items.description: Pick a site by name search; altitude and country fill in automatically. Every place appears with its map in your list.

items.title: Wings at a glance
items.description: Solo and tandem wings with age, flight count and checks. Retired equipment moves to the archive without disappearing from the logbook.

captions: Manage sites - Take-off and landing sites

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: The first 25 flights are free and can be added at no cost.
notes: The first 25 flights are free and can be added at no cost.
Price change from 1 February 2023 for new users. Rising server costs force me to charge for the application.
The whole application stays open source. Anyone who wants to contribute to development gets a free account — for life, of course.

items.title: Transparent learning progress
items.description: As an instructor you can see your students' data. So you always know who has how many flights and who still needs work in which area. Your group's progress stays transparent at all times.

items.title: Simple attendance management
items.description: You manage high flights, ground-handling sessions or theory lessons right in the tool. Students accept or decline, and you always know who is joining which course. No more scrolling endless chats — the participant list is one tap away.

items.title: Progress tracking for students
items.description: Your students benefit too once you switch to Flightbook Pro: they use the app to track their flights and manoeuvres, take-off and landing sites. Even the SHV logbook for the exam can be generated directly from the app. They're also always informed about when the next course takes place and who's coming. They can use Flightbook Basic for just 12 francs a year (even after training) to track their progress as pilots.

tandem.title: Flightbook for tandem pilots
tandem.intro: Flying commercially means more than logging flights. Flightbook covers the admin around tandem operations right in the app.

items.title: Capture passenger confirmations
items.description: Capture the SHV-required confirmation of the passenger briefing straight on your phone: personal details, briefing points and the passenger's signature on screen.

items.title: Track income
items.description: Record the amount for each tandem flight and keep track of your income — per season, per month or filtered by period.

items.title: Export confirmations
items.description: All confirmations stay stored in your account and can be exported as PDF or Excel at any time — for your records or on request.

items.title: Brief in several languages
items.description: Your passengers read and sign the confirmation in their own language. You pick the language before handing over the phone.

questions.question: Is Flightbook approved for SHV exams?
questions.answer: Yes, Flightbook is officially approved for SHV exams. Export your logbook as a PDF straight from the app and present it at the exam.

questions.question: Does Flightbook work for paragliders and hang gliders?
questions.answer: Yes, Flightbook suits both paraglider and hang glider pilots. You can manage all your flights, equipment and statistics.

questions.question: Can I upload my IGC files?
questions.answer: Yes, you can upload IGC files directly from your vario or GPS tracker and visualise and analyse your flights.

questions.question: Is Flightbook available for iOS and Android?
questions.answer: Yes, Flightbook is available as a native app for iOS (iPhone/iPad) and Android. Download it for free from the App Store or Google Play.

questions.question: What is Flightbook Schools?
questions.answer: Flightbook Schools is a free solution for flight schools. Instructors can follow their students' progress, manage courses and create individual control sheets. Appointments can be created directly, students get push notifications and can sign up. Instructors always have a clear overview of who is attending.
